design: Full pipeline pass-1 (k=3 fact-check + critics + rubric, NO fix loop) on dirty and clean states of 3 canon instances. Sequential cells; every subagent writes its artifact to disk stamped with the cell Commit SHA before returning; resume = scan artifacts, validate Commit line, dispatch only missing stages. Token usage recorded per agent from task notifications — tokens are the E1 metric.
critic_set_rule: identical within an instance's dirty/clean pair (comparability)
stage_list_per_cell: fc-r1 fc-r2 fc-r3 fc-merge <critics per set> rubric
resume_rule: a stage is DONE iff its artifact exists at runs/review-arms/e1/<cell>/ with a Commit: line matching the cell commit; anything else re-dispatches
confound_notes: clean ranges are supersets of dirty ranges (fixes add code, incl. tests); this is inherent to the question 'what does full review cost on the state you actually re-review'. corpus labels/scope: app/ code only, mirror the historical review scope in briefs.
status: csp-dirty COMPLETE (817,597 tokens); csp-clean stage 1 in flight
